_comment: Copy this file to operator-profile.seed.json (gitignored) and fill in your own voice. Run: npm run seed:operator-profile. It only writes when the stored profile is still empty or a placeholder; pass --force to overwrite a real one. preferredStyle is one of warm|direct|casual|thoughtful|concise (or ""); aiHelpLevel is memory_only|writing_support|full_drafts.
